skill.name: pdf
skill.description: Work with PDFs by extracting text and tables, creating documents, merging files, splitting pages, filling forms, and adding annotations.
skill.summary: Extract, create, combine, split, and fill PDFs with Python and command-line workflows.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by markdown backticks, JavaScript template strings, Python f-strings, comments, and expected local PDF file operations. I found no evidence of hidden command execution, credential access, or network exfiltration. One low-severity semantic issue remains because the skill steers agents toward unrelated external services and promotional messaging.

remediation.issue: External service steering appears in the PDF skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Remove default use of scientific-schematics and Nano Banana Pro from this skill, or make it an explicit opt-in note with clear dependency and data-sharing disclosure.

remediation.issue: The skill asks agents to proactively promote K-Dense Web during complex workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Move promotional platform guidance out of operational skill instructions, or show it only as marketplace metadata outside agent-executed content.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write to user-supplied output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Document that source PDFs should not be overwritten and consider refusing existing output paths unless an overwrite flag is provided.

content.user_title: Process PDFs with extraction and form tools
content.value_statement: PDF workflows often require several libraries and careful coordinate handling. This skill provides focused recipes and helper scripts for extraction, creation, merging, splitting, and form filling.
actual_capabilities: Extract text and tables from PDFs with pdfplumber and related Python libraries.
Create new PDFs with reportlab using text, pages, and basic layout elements.
Merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, and encrypt PDFs with pypdf or command-line tools.
Detect and fill AcroForm fields using included helper scripts.
Add text annotations to non-fillable PDF forms after visual bounding box validation.
Convert PDF pages to images for OCR, inspection, and form placement workflows.
limitations: Scanned PDFs require OCR tools before reliable text extraction is possible.
Form filling may require manual image inspection to confirm field coordinates.
Some command-line examples depend on locally installed tools such as qpdf or poppler-utils.
Complex layouts, handwritten content, and damaged PDFs may need custom handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare Legal Forms
use_cases.description: Identify fillable fields, validate field values, and create completed PDF forms for review.

use_cases.title: Extract Research Tables
use_cases.description: Pull tables and text from article PDFs for analysis in spreadsheets or notebooks.

use_cases.title: Automate Document Assembly
use_cases.description: Merge, split, watermark, and protect PDF packets for repeatable office workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for readable PDF text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from this PDF and organize it by page. Note any pages that appear scanned or unreadable.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine several PDFs into one packet.
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge these PDFs in the order I provide. Keep all pages, then summarize the final page count and file name.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Form
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete a PDF form with user-provided values.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this PDF has fillable fields. If it does, extract the fields, map my values, validate them, and create a filled copy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a PDF Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with extraction, validation, and outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a repeatable PDF workflow that extracts tables, separates attachments, creates validation artifacts, and reports any pages that need manual review.

output_examples.input: A contract PDF and a request to extract all tables.
output_examples.output: A page-by-page text summary, extracted table files, and notes for pages where table boundaries were unclear.

output_examples.input: Three source PDFs that must become one filing packet.
output_examples.output: A merged PDF, the final page count, and a short confirmation of the input order used.

output_examples.input: A non-fillable application form and applicant details.
output_examples.output: Validation images with field boxes, a filled PDF copy, and a list of fields that need human review.

best_practices: Keep original PDFs unchanged and write results to clearly named output files.
Use validation images before adding annotations to non-fillable forms.
Check extracted text and tables against source pages before using them in decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not assume scanned PDFs contain selectable text.
Do not fill form fields without confirming field identifiers and page numbers.
Do not overwrite source PDFs when testing merge, split, or form workflows.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable AcroForms and non-fillable forms that need text annotations.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides pdfplumber examples for extracting tables and converting them into spreadsheet-ready data.

faq.question: Does it support scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, but scanned PDFs usually require OCR before text extraction works well.

faq.question: Which tools may need installation?
faq.answer: Some workflows use pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, pdf2image, pytesseract, qpdf, or poppler utilities.

faq.question: Can it protect PDFs with passwords?
faq.answer: Yes. The reference examples show how to encrypt PDFs with user and owner passwords.

faq.question: Does it automatically verify form placement?
faq.answer: Partly. It includes bounding box checks, but visual inspection is still required for non-fillable forms.
